svg.title: Two conflicting patient records leave the emergency supply drawer locked.
svg.desc: From above, Riju keeps two source records separate while a blank scheduler pane denies treatment allocation. Ananya's hand waits over the still-sealed paper reserve drawer.
svg.text: Page 45, panel 2 · Top-down insert on two blank identity records and a locked supply drawer

text.tspan: The frozen scheduler treats conflicting records as
absence and locks the linked supply release.
